hb-af-exit.objective: Exit the Handelsbanken fondkonto (AF), move net proceeds to Avanza ISK under the ISK allowance, replace 0.66-0.67% fee mixed funds with low-fee (~0.2%) index funds. Addresses priority levers #1 (wrapper) and #2 (fees) simultaneously.

tax_math.method: Genomsnittsmetoden (average cost) - every partial sale realizes gain proportionally; there is no way to sell cost basis first
tax_math.payment_timing: No withholding at sale. Bank reports the gain; tax due with the deklaration for the sale year (spring of the following year). Set aside 8,827 SEK.

hb-af-exit.why_single_step: Swedish capital gains tax is a flat 30% with no annual exemption - phasing sales across years does not reduce the total tax, it only defers part of it while continuing to pay 0.66-0.67% fees plus 0.12%/yr fondskatt plus 30% on all further gains in the AF. The embedded 8,827 SEK tax is owed eventually regardless; selling now only accelerates it. The deferral value of that acceleration is smaller than one year of ongoing AF drag under any plausible return assumption (details in reports/2026-07-07-hb-exit-plan.md).
steps: 1. Confirm with Handelsbanken there are no exit/redemption fees on either fund (typically none for Swedish funds; the 0.66-0.67% is annual, not exit).
2. Sell both funds in full in a single order round.

3. Transfer full proceeds (~134,900 SEK) to Avanza ISK. Post-move ISK total ~171k SEK - under the ISK allowance, so ongoing ISK tax on this capital is zero at current levels (verify current threshold with Skatteverket).

4. Reinvest inside ISK per the Council's target allocation. Fund selection is priority lever #4 - do not stall the wrapper+fee fix (levers #1-2) waiting on a perfect pick; a broad global index fund at ~0.2% captures the structural win.
5. Keep 8,827 SEK earmarked (buffer or bankkonto) for the tax bill at next deklaration - do not invest money that is already owed to Skatteverket.

6. Update this file when trades are actually placed: zero out hb-main, itemize the new ISK holdings, and mark this plan EXECUTED with the actual sale prices (they will differ from the 2026-07-07 statement values).
coordination: Loss netting: gains on listed funds sit in the 'aktiefallan' and are offset 100% by same-year losses on listed shares/funds. If any listed holding is at a loss and its exit is planned anyway, realize it in the same calendar year.

ETH caveat: crypto losses (K4 section D, 'ovriga tillgangar') are only 70% deductible and net differently - do NOT sell ETH at a loss purely to offset these fund gains; the ETH decision stands on its own. ETH cost basis is still unknown (open question).
Market-timing is explicitly NOT part of this plan - the edge here is structural (wrapper + fees), and time out of market during the transfer should be minimized (days, not weeks).
